# Ticktick

TickTick is a cross-platform task management and to-do list application designed to help users organize their tasks and schedules efficiently.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/ticktick/.

## Actions

- **Complete Task**: Mark a task as complete.
- **Complete Task**: Mark a specific task as complete.
- **Create Project**: Create a new project in ticktick.
- **Create Task**: Create a new task in ticktick.
- **Delete Task**: Delete a specific task.
- **Delete TickTick Project**: Delete a specific project.
- **Generate OAuth2 Authorization URL**: Generate the ticktick oauth2 authorization url.
- **Get project with data**: Retrieve a project and its associated data (tasks, columns).
- **Get User Projects**: Retrieve all projects for the user.
- **Redirect to TickTick OAuth2 authorization page**: Redirect user to ticktick authorization page to obtain authorization code.
- **Update Project**: Update an existing project.
- **Update Project**: Update an existing project.
- **Update Task**: Update an existing task.
